bio1: In God we trust, never will I be able to thank President Trump enough for the wake-up call to save our country. MAGA till death do us part.
bio2: I mostly repost good gabs when I see them. Consider this a vote of confidence in whatever wisdom I'm sharing with you today.
bio3: Patriot, Christian, husband, father, veteran, and unapologetic Trump supporter. Freedom isn't free, but worth fighting for every day.
bio4: I've got the heart of a hippie, soul of a gypsy, charm of a pixie, and swagger of a pirate. Let's dance through this crazy world together!
bio5: God, country, family - in that order. I'm a proud American who believes in living life to its fullest while fighting for our freedoms.
bio6: I move very simple: love God, love others, and never stop learning. Life's too short for complexity or hatred.
bio7: Antifa is a terrorist group that hates America. We must protect our borders, our people, and our way of life from their evil influence.
bio8: I'm an artist with a passion for the good, beautiful, and true. Join me on a journey of self-discovery and creative expression.
bio9: Censorship is the child of fear and father of ignorance. Let's stand up for free speech and the right to think for ourselves!
bio10: I'm a Christian, Constitutional conservative, and proud Texan. My faith, family, and freedom are non-negotiable - come and take it!
